learning_objective: 🎯 Travel back in time to the Indus Valley and discover how ancient Indians built super smart cities with covered drains and baked bricks!

main_concepts.concept_title: رود Early Cities by the River
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Thousands of years ago, people realized that living near rivers was a great idea because they had water for drinking and farming. This is how the amazing Indus Valley Civilisation began!

Cities like Harappa and Mohenjo-daro were built like modern neighborhoods! They had straight roads cutting at right angles, houses made of strong baked bricks, and even covered drains to keep the streets clean.

Archaeologists found special flat, square objects called seals with pictures of animals and unknown writing on them. These seals were probably used like stamps for trading goods with other ancient cities!

fun_activity.title: 🧱 Lego City Planner
fun_activity.instructions: Use building blocks or Lego to design your own Harappan city! Make sure to include straight roads, a raised citadel for important buildings, and a pretend drainage system.

quick_recap: ⭐ The Indus Valley Civilisation is one of the oldest and most advanced ancient societies.
⭐ They built incredible, well-planned cities with baked bricks and a world-class drainage system.
⭐ They used mysterious stone seals for trade, and we are still trying to read their secret language!
